item.title: PS5 Welcome Hub Adds Another Animated Wallpaper Perfect for Winter
item.description: Sony has quietly added another new wallpaper to PS5's Welcome hub. It's been doing this slowly ever since the console's landing screen was introduced; the last one was a very cosy animated fireplace scene, complete with its own audio. Now, you can choose a fresh backdrop, and it's suitably wintry.

item.title: Shadow of the Tomb Raider Temporarily Free on PlayStation Store, Likely Due to Glitch
item.description: Shadow of the Tomb Raider Definitive Edition is temporarily claimable for free on the PlayStation Store in select Asian regions due to an apparent store glitch.

item.title: Epic Games Store Confirms Bloodstained as December 23 Free Game
item.description: Epic Games Store reveals Bloodstained Ritual of the Night as its December 23 free title, available to claim for 24 hours as part of the holiday giveaway.

item.title: 007 First Light delayed to May 27, 2026
item.description: IO Interactive has delayed 007 First Light from its previously planned March 27, 2026 release date to May 27, 2026. It will be available for PlayStation 5, Xbox Series, Switch 2, and PC via Steam and Epic Games Store.
